items.title: 3 reasons software stocks are making a comeback
items.summary: Software stocks (IGV) have moved into the green after several difficult months driven by AI disruption fears. Citizens head of technology equity research, Pat Walravens, sits down with Market Domination host Josh Lipton to explain why software is rebounding and what to expect going forward.

items.title: What Nvidia's stellar Q2 earnings represent for AI in the rest of 2026
items.summary: After a huge earnings season for Big Tech capped off with blowout second quarter results from Nvidia (NVDA), LPL Financial chief technical strategist Adam Turnquist weighs in on what this could mean for the AI narrative in the second half of 2026.

items.title: There Was No Beating Moderna in August. These Are the Best and Worst S&P 500 Stocks for the Month.
items.summary: Moderna stock surged 158% in August to lead the S&P 500, while Edison International plunged 27% to rank last in the index.

items.title: Software Stocks & ETFs: Is the AI Sell-Off Over?
items.summary: We examine why software stocks are rebounding and highlight software ETFs.

items.title: Adobe's Options Price A Year That Runs Past Its Own Range
items.summary: Adobe’s option-implied range runs from below anything the stock has traded at in the past year to far above its high, and that width is the real question for anyone who owns it.

items.title: 3 Earnings Winners Setting Up for Another Leg Higher
items.summary: Okta, Gartner and Salesforce all crushed earnings, demonstrating strong business, and now stock price momentum.

items.title: The Bill For Oracle's AI Build Arrived Before The Revenue
items.summary: Record bookings are not near-term revenue, and the spending needed to serve them lands first.

items.title: Apple vs. Salesforce: The Better Stock May Not Be the One You Expect
items.summary: Apple just posted a record quarter and Salesforce blew past earnings expectations, but the headline numbers on both stocks hide something the market may be mispricing. One trades at a steep discount to the other, and the cheaper one might be doing more with AI right now.
